record.paper_title: Some open problems in spectral theory
record.original_question: Let H be a Hilbert space and let A:H -> H be a closed densely defined operator that is the generator of a semigroup. Can the resolvent norm λ -> ||(A - λI)^(-1)|| be constant on a nonempty open subset of the resolvent set of A?

evidence.quote: Question (J. R. Partington): Let H be a Hilbert space and suppose a closed densely defined operator A : H → H is a generator of a semigroup. Can k(A − λI)−1 k be constant on an open set?
Hille-Yosida: k(A − λI)−1 k = O(1/λ) as λ → +∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space and let $A : \mathcal{D}(A) \subset H 	o H$ be a closed, densely defined linear operator that generates a strongly continuous (one-parameter) semigroup $\{T(t)\}_{t\ge 0}$ on $H$. Let $ho(A) \subset \mathbb{C}$ denote the resolvent set of $A$, and for $\lambda \in ho(A)$ let $R(\lambda,A) = (A - \lambda I)^{-1}$ be the resolvent, with operator norm $\|R(\lambda,A)\|$.

Note that by the Hille–Yosida theorem one has $\|R(\lambda,A)\| = O(1/\lambda)$ as $\lambda 	o +\infty$ along the real axis, so the resolvent norm cannot be constant on an unbounded set of this type.

Question: Does there exist such an operator $A$ for which the function $\lambda \mapsto \|R(\lambda,A)\|$ is constant on some nonempty open subset of $ho(A)$? Equivalently, can $\|(A - \lambda I)^{-1}\|$ be (locally) constant on an open set in the resolvent set of a semigroup generator on a Hilbert space?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not surface a published resolution of Partington's question for semigroup generators on Hilbert spaces. Related results are known: on general Banach spaces the resolvent norm can be constant on open sets (Globevnik, Shargorodsky), but for Hilbert spaces this is known to fail for normal/self-adjoint operators, and the semigroup-generator case appears not to have been definitively settled in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Eventually norm continuous semigroups on Hilbert space
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of norm continuous semigroups on Hilbert spaces via resolvent behavior on vertical lines.
status_evidence.claim: Resolvent norm behavior is actively studied for Hilbert-space semigroup generators, but no result asserting (im)possibility of constancy on open sets was located.

status_evidence.title: From resolvent bounds to semigroup bounds
status_evidence.snippet: Relates decay/growth of resolvent norms to semigroup norms.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references on resolvent norm behavior do not address Partington's specific question about constancy on an open set.
